scope: Real Nordic transport observations decoded to vendor controls; no OpenXR action/profile assignment, pose, radio TX, MCU or SDK call in controls-only mode.

wire_boundary.transport: Existing nordic-stream JSONL rx field,36 actual bytes; ignore all producer-derived fields and decode rx again.
wire_boundary.validation: Strict A55A, META key=p[1] XOR p[0],p[2..33],retain p[1],sum8 inclusive of p[1].
wire_boundary.payload_offsets: Offsets below refer to the decoded34-byte payload.

corrected_prior_interpretation.replacement: payload1_low_nibble = p[1]&15, neutral observation; not a button field
corrected_prior_interpretation.compatibility: Incorrect alias removed from reference structure and nordic-stream JSON. No false-compatible alias retained. Existing helper parses raw rx, so its input prefix remains unchanged.

state_and_time.source: CLOCK_MONOTONIC transport completion timestamp, not wireless sample time or XrTime.
state_and_time.known_fields: seen_mask only after actual corresponding mode; updated_mask covers current packet only.
state_and_time.separate_receipts: mode1_receipt_monotonic_ns and joystick_receipt_monotonic_ns, each with its own source sequence. Mode2 cannot refresh button/touch/finger state and mode1 cannot refresh joystick.
state_and_time.pattern_gate: Per-hand real type2 head_version={p24,p23,p22}. For version third>=25,power=p25&15,gzll=p25>>4; otherwise power=p25 and GZLL unknown. Original head_pwr callback sets enable only for power3. GZLL state3 is not asserted paired.
state_and_time.clear_on_state: Initial/changed head version or enable transition clears all old control values. Any non-enabled pattern clears them; reenabling does not resurrect old values.
state_and_time.freshness_policy: Local consumer policy; not recovered vendor disconnect timeout. now>=receipt and now-receipt<limit, Pattern known,stock_enable required for each valid mask bit. No dependence on pose confidence or IMU quaternion.
state_and_time.replay: valid_mask=0/input_active=false always; historical records never active inputs.
state_and_time.release: Consumers MUST recompute freshness per field on each use, release absent/expired bits, and release all controls on EOF/error/source restart. Helper emits expired changes while transport lines continue and explicit both-hand zero masks/values on normal EOF. A killed/stalled producer cannot be relied on to emit a final line.
state_and_time.wire_clock: Original IMU BOOTTIME scale/33ms gates remain unchanged; controls do not claim or manufacture wireless synchronization.

jsonl.field_validity: valid_mask is at emission time only; consumers recompute against receipt/max_age at consumption. Raw stale values are diagnostic, never active actions.
jsonl.raw_not_jni: The fields intentionally precede JNI per-hand transforms and button policy. No A/B/menu names or normalized OpenXR axes/trigger are assigned.

jni_boundary.observed: Left callback swaps and negates bytes; right swaps. Getter clamps to [-80,80]. Raw serial axes therefore are not claimed as OpenXR coordinates.
jni_boundary.limitation: JNI also remaps touch/button bits and uses a left-side configuration gate. Physical control labels and configuration semantics remain unverified; not reproduced by this raw adapter.

entrypoints.arm64: a081-controller-controls [--controls-only] [--seconds1..120], built with A081_CONTROLLER_CONTROLS_ONLY; --sdk rejected, no loader/SDK code present.
entrypoints.historical_replay: --replay; no SDK calls, all validity inactive.
entrypoints.input: Exact existing nordic-stream raw JSONL on stdin. The helper itself opens no Nordic device.

address_convention: Listed addresses are ELF VA with Thumb bit cleared; REA/Ghidra observed addresses add0x10000.
